amendment.description: An amendment numbered 27 printed in Part A of House Report 119-749 to increase withholding of assistance to Nigeria from 50% to 100%, keeping metrics in place that force Nigeria to take effective steps to prevent and respond to violence in the country.

vote.text: On agreeing to the Steube amendment (A008) Agreed to by voice vote.

action.text: House amendment agreed to: On agreeing to the Steube amendment (A008) Agreed to by voice vote.
